title: Shanghai International Children’s Book Fair 2024
summary: Our third international fair with our own stand, in the Asian market.
body:
Our third international fair with our own stand took us to the Asian market, with rights meetings and conversations with printers and manufacturers.

[Read our report from the fair](/news/shanghai-international-childrens-book-fair-2024/)
